paper: Physics-Driven Spatiotemporal Modeling for AI-Generated Video Detection (NSG-VD, Zhang, Lian, Yang, Li, Pang, Liu, Han, Li, Tan, NeurIPS 2025 Spotlight, arXiv 2510.08073)
training_set_in_paper: Table 3 of the paper (the NSG-VD MMD-MP row): the deep kernel trained on 10,000 Kinetics-400 reals + 1,000 SEINE fakes. The key serves the official checkpoint unbalance-SEINE-mp.pth (no SynthScope-trained model; the official train_dMMD.py is not wrapped). The statistic is the deep-kernel MMD between a video's normalized spatiotemporal gradient features (guided-diffusion 256x256) and 100 MSR-VTT val reference videos; a video is generated iff it is > 1. The paper's subsets (~120 per generator) are unspecified, so the paper tables are NOT reproduced; the authors' released results CSV (500 per generator, Sora 51 + 56) is, with the official code on our data and with SynthScope. Metrics are the official ones: pooled accuracy (not balanced), recall / precision / F1 on the fake class, AUROC of the raw statistic. ffmpeg 4.2 is required (the build changes the frames). Exact parity with the official code at its own batching; the served path (1 video per diffusion pass and MMD batch) differs from the official batching (3 per pass, MMD batches of 24) by up to 0.27 per video.

benchmarks.name: GenVideo-Val, released-CSV protocol (500 per generator; Sora 51 + 56) vs the released CSV (not the paper)
benchmarks.metric: pooled accuracy and AUROC of the MMD statistic (fake iff statistic > 1), mean over the 10 generators; 500 MSR-VTT test reals (from index 200 of the split) + the first 500 test fakes per generator, Sora 56 reals + 51 fakes

paper_number.note: NOT the paper: the 10-generator averages of the authors' released results CSV assets/nsg-vd-test_results/unbalance-SEINE-mmd-mp.csv (the released checkpoint on the released protocol).

our_number.note: 'Paper' column = the released CSV, not the paper. Reproduces the released CSV (500/generator, Sora 51+56), not the paper's tables. Avg accuracy 90.47 SynthScope, 90.37 official code, CSV 90.37. Sora AUROC 0.37 below the CSV, unexplained. Needs ffmpeg 4.2.

benchmarks.gap_cause: Per generator, accuracy / recall / F1 / precision are within 0.43 of the CSV for both paths. Unexplained: Sora AUROC is below the CSV for every checkpoint (this key: official code 95.03, SynthScope 95.50, CSV 95.87). The served path scores one video per diffusion pass (official: 3) and per MMD batch (official: 24), which flips about 30 of 9,107 verdicts (Avg accuracy differs by up to 0.27); on 75 videos the MMD batch alone reproduces that gap for the mp keys, not measured on the 9,107.
benchmarks.dataset_source: GenVideo-Val (ModelScope cccnju/Gen-Video), reals = MSR-VTT; result file repro/nsg_vd_benchmark_genvideo_val.json (checkpoints.unbalance-SEINE-mp.L500), repro/bench_results/nsg_vd_unbalance_genvideo_split500.json

benchmarks.name: GenVideo-Val, paper Table 3 (~120 per generator, subsets unspecified) vs the first-120 approximation
benchmarks.metric: pooled accuracy and AUROC (fake iff statistic > 1), mean over the 10 generators; L120 = the first 120 of each official list (Sora 51 + 56), an APPROXIMATION of the paper's subsets

paper_number.note: Paper Table 3 (trained on 10,000 Kinetics-400 reals + 1,000 SEINE fakes), NSG-VD (Ours) row, Avg. column; the test subsets are not specified.

our_number.note: NOT reproduced: the paper's ~120-per-generator subsets are unspecified; first-120 approximation only. Avg accuracy 91.23 vs 89.16, recall 98.58 vs 93.21. The authors' released CSV differs from the paper too (recall 98.44).

benchmarks.gap_cause: The paper's NSG-VD rows imply 120 reals + 120 fakes per generator (68.33 = 82/120) and 56 + 56 for Sora, but Appendix C gives no counts or selection rule, test.yaml uses 500, and the released val splits have 62-140 ids for the nine generators other than Sora (Sora's has 5); even the released CSVs differ from the paper by up to 5.23 points on average. Not reproduced.
